cases.comparison: Handshake attributes session and process-group identity; native errno and candidate status/diagnostic are retained, plus full participant output.

cases.purpose: Compare the requested owned foreground job and restored shell group using the independent PTY driver.
cases.oracle: Native tcsetpgrp control and the same independent PTY driver with live pidfd/birth/ancestry and sampled foreground group.
cases.comparison: Driver independently samples requested job and restored owner while each is held at a private FIFO; no foreground observer command runs after the candidate switch.
cases.candidate_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $UID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
umask 077
/usr/bin/mkfifo "$HOME/foreground-proof-gate" || exit 98
exec 8<>"$HOME/foreground-proof-gate" || exit 98
set -m
/usr/bin/sleep 12 &
job=$!
set +m
printf '%s\n' "$job" >"$HOME/foreground-request.raw"
printf '%s\n' "$$" >"$HOME/foreground-owner.raw"
trap 'kill "$job" 2>/dev/null || :; wait "$job" 2>/dev/null || :' EXIT
trap '' TTOU
ready=0
for ((i=0; i<100; i++)); do
  if kill -0 -- "-$job" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
  IFS= read -r -n 1 -t 0.02 -u 8 ignored || :
done
(( ready == 1 )) || exit 98
printf 'FOREGROUND-ARMED\n'
pty foreground "$job" 0 >"$HOME/foreground-switch.out" 2>"$HOME/foreground-switch.err"; rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$HOME/foreground-switch-status.raw"
(( rc == 0 )) || exit 1
printf 'FOREGROUND-SWITCHED\n'
IFS= read -r -n 1 -u 8 gate || exit 98
[[ $gate == G ]] || exit 98
pty foreground "$$" 0 >"$HOME/foreground-restore.out" 2>"$HOME/foreground-restore.err"; rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$HOME/foreground-restore-status.raw"
(( rc == 0 )) || exit 1
printf 'FOREGROUND-RESTORED\n'
IFS= read -r -n 1 -u 8 gate || exit 98
[[ $gate == G ]] || exit 98
cases.reference_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $UID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
exec /usr/bin/python3 -c '
import os, signal, subprocess
signal.signal(signal.SIGTTOU, signal.SIG_IGN)
home=os.environ["HOME"]; path=home+"/foreground-proof-gate"
os.mkfifo(path,0o600); gate=os.open(path,os.O_RDWR|os.O_CLOEXEC)
child=subprocess.Popen(["/usr/bin/sleep","12"],preexec_fn=lambda:os.setpgid(0,0))
def write(name,value):
 with open(home+"/"+name,"w") as out: out.write(value)
try:
 write("foreground-request.raw",str(child.pid)+"\n")
 write("foreground-owner.raw",str(os.getpgrp())+"\n")
 print("FOREGROUND-ARMED",flush=True)
 os.tcsetpgrp(0,child.pid);write("foreground-switch-status.raw","0\n")
 print("FOREGROUND-SWITCHED",flush=True)
 if os.read(gate,1)!=b"G": raise RuntimeError("first gate")
 os.tcsetpgrp(0,os.getpgrp());write("foreground-restore-status.raw","0\n")
 print("FOREGROUND-RESTORED",flush=True)
 if os.read(gate,1)!=b"G": raise RuntimeError("second gate")
finally:
 child.terminate();child.wait(timeout=3);os.close(gate)
'
